title: Pure Vylon
summary: Pure Vylon LIGHT Synchro and Equip loop strategy, uniting Machine, Fairy, and Thunder lightforms around continuous equipment cycling. The deck utilizes the famous Vylon Element loop alongside Rod of Silence - Kay'est to chain-summon Tuners from the Deck and erect the multi-negating boss Vylon Omega.

summary.title: Starters
points: Vylon Cube adds any Equip Spell Card (Rod of Silence - Kay'est, Vylon Material, or Mage Power) from your Deck to your hand when sent to the GY for the Synchro Summon of a LIGHT monster.
Photon Thrasher Special Summons itself from hand while you control no monsters, pairing with Level 3 Vylon Cube for an instant Level 7 Synchro Summon.
Solar Wind Jammer and Cyber Dragon Special Summon themselves as Level 5 LIGHT Machines on an empty field, pairing with Level 3 Cube for Level 8 Vylon Epsilon or Level 2 Tetra for Level 7 Vylon Delta.
Vylon Element is a Continuous Spell that Special Summons 1 Vylon Tuner directly from your Deck with no once-per-turn limit whenever a face-up Vylon Equip Card you control is destroyed.
Vylon Sphere and Vylon Prism equip themselves to a monster from the GY by paying 500 LP, triggering Element when destroyed.

summary.title: The Vylon Element Loop
steps: Special Summon Photon Thrasher (or Solar Wind Jammer) and Normal Summon Vylon Cube.
Synchro Summon Level 7 Vylon Delta (or Vylon Sigma) using Photon Thrasher and Vylon Cube; Cube triggers in GY to add Rod of Silence - Kay'est from Deck to hand.
Activate Vylon Element, then equip Rod of Silence - Kay'est to your Synchro Monster.
Equip any Vylon Equip Spell (such as Vylon Material) to the monster equipped with Kay'est; Kay'est immediately destroys the Vylon Equip Spell.
Trigger both cards: Vylon Material searches another Vylon Spell (Vylon Segment) from Deck, and Vylon Element Special Summons Level 1 Vylon Sphere from Deck.
Repeat the loop with subsequent Vylon Equips to summon Level 2 Vylon Tetra, assembling Level 7 Delta + Level 2 Tetra + Level 1 Sphere to Double-Tuner Synchro Summon Vylon Omega.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Vylon Omega is a Level 10 Synchro boss (2 Tuners + 1 non-Tuner Vylon) that destroys all face-up Normal Summoned and Set monsters on summon, equips a Vylon monster from GY once per turn, and sends an Equip Card equipped to itself to the GY as a Quick Effect to negate any monster effect and destroy it.

Vylon Epsilon prevents Equip Cards equipped to it from being targeted, and sends an Equip Card equipped to it to the GY to target and destroy an opponent monster, triggering the Equip's floating search.
Vylon Sigma equips any Equip Spell (such as Mage Power) directly from your Deck to itself when it declares an attack while being your only monster.
Vylon Delta adds any Equip Spell Card from your Deck to your hand during your End Phase while in Defense Position.
Vylon Disigma is a Rank 4 Xyz that equips an opponent's Attack Position Effect Monster to itself and automatically destroys monsters it battles with matching Attributes.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Vylon Material gives +600 ATK and searches any Vylon Spell Card from your Deck when sent from the field to the GY.
Vylon Segment protects the equipped monster from targeting by opponent monster and Trap effects, and searches a Vylon Spell when sent to GY.
Vylon Component grants piercing battle damage and searches a Vylon Spell when sent to GY.
Vylon Matter targets 3 Equip Spells in your GY, shuffles them into the Deck, and either draws 1 card or destroys 1 card your opponent controls.
Rod of Silence - Kay'est provides 500 DEF and negates and destroys any other Spell Card that targets the equipped monster, fueling the endless destruction loop.

allow.Rod of Silence - Kay'est: Core combo enabler for the Vylon Element Loop: while equipped to a monster, its continuous effect states 'Destroy any Spell Card that targets the equipped monster, other than this card, and negate its effect'—so equipping Vylon Material/Segment/Component to that monster immediately destroys the Vylon Equip Spell, triggering Vylon Element to summon a Vylon Tuner from your Deck AND triggering the Vylon Equip's GY effect to search another Vylon Equip Spell to repeat the loop!
allow.Cyber Dragon: Level 5 LIGHT Machine that Special Summons itself when only your opponent controls a monster—pairing with Level 3 Tuner Vylon Cube to immediately Synchro Summon Level 8 Vylon Epsilon (5 + 3 = 8) or with Level 2 Vylon Tetra for Level 7 Vylon Delta (5 + 2 = 7) while Vylon Cube searches Rod of Silence - Kay'est!
allow.Solar Wind Jammer: Level 5 LIGHT Machine that Special Summons itself from your hand when you control no monsters (and becomes Level 5 on Turn 1), pairing with Level 3 Tuner Vylon Cube for an instant Level 8 Vylon Epsilon or Level 2 Vylon Tetra for Level 7 Vylon Delta!
allow.Photon Thrasher: Level 4 LIGHT Warrior that Special Summons itself when you control no monsters; pairs with Level 3 Tuner Vylon Cube for an instant Level 7 Vylon Delta or Vylon Sigma (4 + 3 = 7, triggering Vylon Cube to search Rod of Silence - Kay'est or Mage Power!), or with Level 4 Tuner Vylon Prism for Level 8 Vylon Epsilon (4 + 4 = 8)!
allow.Mage Power: Equip Spell searched by Vylon Cube or Vylon Delta that gives a Vylon Synchro +500 ATK/DEF for every Spell/Trap you control (+2500 ATK alongside Vylon Element and 3 Equips!).

main: Vylon Cube

Core Level 3 LIGHT Machine Tuner: if this card is sent to the GY for the Synchro Summon of a LIGHT monster, adds ANY Equip Spell Card ('Rod of Silence - Kay'est', 'Vylon Material', or 'Mage Power'!) from your Deck to your hand!
Vylon Prism

Core Level 4 LIGHT Thunder Tuner (1500 ATK): if this card is sent from the Monster Zone to the GY, pays 500 LP to equip itself to a monster you control—giving that monster +1000 ATK during damage calculation (or destroying itself under Kay'est to trigger Vylon Element!)!
Vylon Sphere

Core Level 1 LIGHT Machine Tuner: if sent from the Monster Zone to the GY, pays 500 LP to equip itself to a monster you control; then sends this Equip Card to the GY to target ANY Equip Spell in your GY and equip it to that monster (essential for double-Tuner Synchro Summoning Vylon Omega: Level 7 Vylon Delta + Level 2 Vylon Tetra + Level 1 Vylon Sphere = Level 10 Vylon Omega!)!
Vylon Tetra

Level 2 LIGHT Machine Tuner: if sent from the Monster Zone to the GY, pays 500 LP to equip itself to a monster you control and destroys itself instead if the equipped monster would be destroyed; pairs with Level 1 Sphere + Level 7 Delta/Sigma to summon Vylon Omega!
Vylon Soldier
Level 4 LIGHT Fairy non-Tuner (1700 ATK) that serves as an in-archetype non-Tuner for Vylon Element and Vylon Matter.
Photon Thrasher

Level 4 LIGHT Warrior that Special Summons itself when you control no monsters; Normal Summoning Level 3 Vylon Cube next to it immediately Synchro Summons Level 7 Vylon Delta or Vylon Sigma while Vylon Cube searches an Equip Spell!
Solar Wind Jammer
Level 5 LIGHT Machine that Special Summons itself when you control no monsters; pairs with Level 3 Vylon Cube for Level 8 Vylon Epsilon or with Level 2 Vylon Tetra for Level 7 Vylon Delta.
Cyber Dragon
Level 5 LIGHT Machine extender that pairs with Vylon Cube for Level 8 Vylon Epsilon or Vylon Tetra for Level 7 Vylon Delta.
Vylon Element

Core Continuous Spell: whenever a face-up 'Vylon' Equip Card(s) you control is destroyed (such as by Rod of Silence - Kay'est!), Special Summons 1 'Vylon' Tuner monster directly from your Deck (NOT once per turn!)!
Vylon Material

Archetypal Equip Spell (equips only to a Vylon monster): gives +600 ATK; if this face-up card on the field is sent to the GY (including when destroyed by Kay'est!), adds ANY 'Vylon' Spell Card (Vylon Element, Vylon Segment, Vylon Component, or Vylon Matter!) from your Deck to your hand!
Vylon Segment

Archetypal Equip Spell (equips only to a Vylon monster): the equipped monster cannot be targeted by your opponent's monster or Trap effects; if this face-up card on the field is sent to the GY, adds ANY 'Vylon' Spell Card from your Deck to your hand!
Vylon Component
Archetypal Equip Spell (equips only to a Vylon monster): grants piercing battle damage; if this face-up card on the field is sent to the GY, adds ANY 'Vylon' Spell Card from your Deck to your hand!
Vylon Matter

Normal Spell (searchable by every Vylon Equip Spell!): targets 3 Equip Spell Cards in your GY, shuffles them into the Deck, and either draws 1 card OR destroys 1 card your opponent controls—resetting your Vylon Equips into the Deck to keep the Vylon Element Loop going!
Rod of Silence - Kay'est

Searched by Vylon Cube or Vylon Delta: equips to a monster and automatically destroys any other Spell Card that targets that monster—instantly destroying any Vylon Equip Spell you equip to it so both Vylon Element AND the Vylon Equip's GY search trigger!
Mage Power
Searched by Vylon Cube or Vylon Sigma to give your Vylon Synchros up to +2500 ATK.
